items.title: Speciesformer learns conserved cellular states for cross-species generative virtual cell modeling
items.abstract_or_text: Cells across species are governed by evolutionarily conserved biological programs, yet their molecular states and responses are reshaped by species, tissue and cellular context. A central challenge for virtual cell modeling is therefore to learn cellular states and state transitions that separate transferable biological principles from context-specific variation. Existing single-cell foundation models have advanced cellular representation learning, but most remain focused on single-species analysis, discriminative tasks or specialized forms of generation. Here we present Speciesformer, a cross-species generative single-cell foundation model that integrates evolutionary representation learning with virtual cell-state generation. Speciesformer is pretrained on SpeciesCorpus, comprising 131 million cells from 11 species, 154 tissues, and more than 923 cell types, and maps species-specific genes into a shared evolution-informed gene space. Its encoder learns transferable cell and gene representations that support biological representation probing and cross-species knowledge transfer, providing a common state space for resolving conserved and context-dependent cellular programs. Building on this shared representation, Speciesformer uses a unified generative architecture to model cellular states and state transitions under semantic and interventional conditions, enabling bidirectional generation between transcriptomic states and biological text descriptions, as well as prediction of post-perturbation transcriptomes from initial cell states and intervention descriptions, including in previously unobserved cellular contexts. By unifying evolutionary variation, biological semantics and conditional state transitions, Speciesformer extends cross-species foundation modeling toward a generative virtual cell framework for representing, describing and predicting cellular states across biological contexts.
items.summary_zh: Speciesformer 以 11 个物种、1.31 亿个细胞预训练，尝试把跨物种表征学习与条件化虚拟细胞生成统一起来。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 数据规模和跨物种设计突出；但生成及未见细胞情境下的预测能力仍需独立实验验证。
items.abstract_zh: 不同物种的细胞受进化上保守的生物学程序支配，但其分子状态和响应会因物种、组织及细胞背景而重塑。因此，虚拟细胞建模的一个核心挑战，是学习能够将可迁移的生物学原理与背景特异性变异分开的细胞状态和状态转换。现有单细胞基础模型推进了细胞表征学习，但大多数仍聚焦于单物种分析、判别任务或专门形式的生成。在此，我们提出 Speciesformer：一个跨物种生成式单细胞基础模型，将进化表征学习与虚拟细胞状态生成相结合。Speciesformer 在 SpeciesCorpus 上预训练；该语料库包含来自 11 个物种、154 种组织和超过 923 种细胞类型的 1.31 亿个细胞，并将物种特异基因映射到一个共享的、受进化启发的基因空间。其编码器学习可迁移的细胞和基因表征，以支持生物学表征探测和跨物种知识迁移，并提供一个用于解析保守及背景依赖细胞程序的共同状态空间。在这一共享表征基础上，Speciesformer 使用统一的生成架构，在语义及干预条件下对细胞状态和状态转换建模，从而能够在转录组状态与生物学文本描述之间双向生成，并可根据初始细胞状态和干预描述预测干预后的转录组，包括在此前未观察到的细胞背景中。通过统一进化变异、生物学语义和条件化状态转换，Speciesformer 将跨物种基础建模推进为一个生成式虚拟细胞框架，用于跨生物学背景表征、描述和预测细胞状态。
items.author_line: Wang J, Dong J, Li G, Fang C, Liu L, Gao X

items.title: Coevolutionary mining of prokaryotic non-coding elements with a genome language model
items.abstract_or_text: Microbial genomes encode compact molecular machines and diverse non-coding RNAs (ncRNAs) essential to gene regulation, pathogenesis, and many foundational biotechnologies. However, annotation remains largely protein-centric and homology-driven. Here, we introduce Minerva, a framework for coevolutionary mining that uses genome language models to predict local interactions directly from sequence as two-dimensional maps. Introducing two complementary techniques, categorical Jacobian fingerprinting and interaction heads, we demonstrate fast, accurate, alignment-free prediction of ncRNA base-pairing, monomeric protein contacts, and repetitive sequence motifs. Applied to 150 bacterial genomes, Minerva recovers known systems and predicts that 84.3% of predicted intergenic base-pairing falls outside of known annotations. In Pseudomonas, we find that the widespread TwoAYGGAY ncRNA family carries large secondary-structure extensions and is often flanked by short upstream repetitive motifs and larger downstream genomic repeats. Interpreting the coevolution maps, we find that Minerva emergently detects open-reading-frame (ORF) signatures at the DNA level despite never being trained to do so. In prophages within these genomes, we discover that Unknown Group 27 (UG27) reverse transcriptase systems encode arrays of structurally conserved yet sequence-diverse ncRNAs that template complementary DNA (cDNA) hairpin products. Together, these results establish coevolutionary mining as a scalable route to genome annotation and biological discovery across the rapidly expanding microbial universe.
items.summary_zh: Minerva 用基因组语言模型的共进化图谱挖掘原核非编码元件，并在 150 个细菌基因组中提出大量未注释碱基配对。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将基因组语言模型用于无比对的结构与非编码 RNA 发现，兼具可扩展性和具体的生物学候选发现。
items.abstract_zh: 微生物基因组编码紧凑的分子机器和多样的非编码 RNA（ncRNAs），后者对基因调控、致病性和许多基础生物技术至关重要。然而，注释仍主要以蛋白质为中心并依赖同源性。在此，我们介绍 Minerva，一种共进化挖掘框架；它利用基因组语言模型以二维图的形式直接从序列预测局部相互作用。通过引入两种互补技术——分类 Jacobian 指纹和相互作用头——我们展示了对 ncRNA 碱基配对、单体蛋白接触和重复序列基序进行快速、准确且无需比对的预测。在 150 个细菌基因组中的应用表明，Minerva 可恢复已知系统，并预测 84.3% 的预测基因间碱基配对位于已知注释之外。在 Pseudomonas 中，我们发现广泛存在的 TwoAYGGAY ncRNA 家族携带大型二级结构延伸，且常侧翼为短的上游重复基序和更大的下游基因组重复序列。解释这些共进化图谱后，我们发现 Minerva 在从未为此训练的情况下，能够在 DNA 水平自发检测开放阅读框（ORF）特征。在这些基因组的前噬菌体中，我们发现 Unknown Group 27（UG27）逆转录酶系统编码结构保守但序列多样的 ncRNA 阵列，这些 ncRNA 为互补 DNA（cDNA）发夹产物提供模板。综上，这些结果确立了共进化挖掘作为一条可扩展路径，用于在快速扩张的微生物宇宙中开展基因组注释和生物学发现。
items.author_line: Li DB, Brixi G, Kim AS, Fiamenghi MB, Driscoll CL, Evans SA, Gao A, Ivanova NN, Kyrpides NC, Deisseroth K, Wilkinson ME, Fischbach MA, Hie B

items.title: Agentic campaign control for high-throughput de novo binder design
items.abstract_or_text: Progress in artificial intelligence has produced a rapidly growing ecosystem of methods for de novo protein design. With access to many specialized and often complementary tools, how does one use them effectively, especially with a finite compute budget? Here, we introduce Target-adaptive Rescue-Explore-eXploit (T-REX), an agentic protein binder design framework that orchestrates multiple state-of-the-art protein generative models and structure evaluators. Over the course of a design campaign, T-REX leverages large language model (LLM) agents to reason over accumulating outcomes and decide whether to rescue promising candidates, explore alternative settings, or exploit productive routes, while a deterministic controller validates and schedules proposed actions.
items.summary_zh: T-REX 让 LLM 智能体在蛋白结合剂设计活动中，在救援、探索和利用策略间调度多个生成及结构评估工具。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把有限计算预算下的蛋白设计流程控制显式化；当前摘要未报告湿实验命中率或端到端基准结果。
items.abstract_zh: 人工智能的进展已产生一个快速增长的 de novo 蛋白设计方法生态系统。在可使用许多专门化且常互补的工具时，尤其在计算预算有限的情况下，如何有效使用它们？在此，我们介绍 Target-adaptive Rescue-Explore-eXploit（T-REX），一个智能体式蛋白结合剂设计框架，可编排多个最先进的蛋白生成模型和结构评估器。在一个设计活动过程中，T-REX 利用大语言模型（LLM）智能体对不断累积的结果进行推理，并决定是救援有前景的候选物、探索替代设置，还是利用高产路线；同时，由确定性控制器验证和调度所提出的操作。
items.author_line: Jeon M, Song J, Kim J, Zhong ED

items.title: Twin-prime editing enables endogenous protein visualization and mutant allele tracking
items.abstract_or_text: Precise analysis of endogenous protein behavior in mosaic tissues requires strategies that both modify native alleles and identify successfully edited cells at single-cell resolution. Here, we establish a CRISPR-based genome-editing platform that combines endogenous protein visualization with allele-specific mutant tracking in vivo. Using the chick neural tube and β-catenin as a model system, we validate cytosine base editing, prime editing, and twin-prime editing by introducing stabilizing mutations that reproduce their expected cellular and morphological phenotypes. We then develop a twin-prime editing strategy that couples installation of a defined oncogenic mutation to simultaneous insertion of minimal peptide tags, thereby making productive editing directly observable at single-cell resolution without clonal selection. Comparative analysis of ALFA, V5, and split-GFP tags identifies split-GFP as the most reliable strategy for endogenous protein visualization in vivo, and fluorescence-based cell selection strongly enriches for the intended twin-prime editing product. Finally, we extend the approach to endogenous wild-type β-catenin, identifying a functionally neutral insertion site that enables visualization at physiological, non-stabilized levels while preserving normal protein behavior. Together, these results establish twin-prime editing as a versatile platform for directly linking precise endogenous genome modification to protein visualization and allele-specific mutation analysis in intact vertebrate tissues.
items.summary_zh: 该研究将 twin-prime editing 与最小肽标签结合，使活体脊椎动物组织中的内源突变等位基因可在单细胞分辨率下追踪。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把精确编辑、内源蛋白可视化和等位基因追踪合并为同一实验读出，具备广泛机制研究价值。
items.abstract_zh: 对嵌合组织中内源蛋白行为的精确分析，需要既能修饰原生等位基因、又能以单细胞分辨率识别成功编辑细胞的策略。在此，我们建立了一个基于 CRISPR 的基因组编辑平台，将内源蛋白可视化与等位基因特异性突变追踪结合于体内。以鸡神经管和 β-catenin 为模型系统，我们通过引入稳定化突变来验证胞嘧啶碱基编辑、prime editing 和 twin-prime editing；这些突变重现了预期的细胞和形态学表型。随后，我们开发了一种 twin-prime editing 策略，将特定致癌突变的安装与最小肽标签的同步插入耦合，从而无需克隆筛选即可在单细胞分辨率下直接观察到有效编辑。对 ALFA、V5 和 split-GFP 标签的比较分析表明，split-GFP 是体内内源蛋白可视化最可靠的策略；基于荧光的细胞筛选可显著富集预期的 twin-prime editing 产物。最后，我们将该方法扩展至内源野生型 β-catenin，识别出一个功能中性的插入位点，使其可在生理性、非稳定化水平下被可视化，同时保持正常的蛋白行为。综上，这些结果将 twin-prime editing 确立为一个通用平台，可在完整脊椎动物组织中直接连接精确的内源基因组修饰、蛋白可视化和等位基因特异性突变分析。
items.author_line: Menendez A, Ramos C, PONS S

items.title: Chemical Proteomics of Residual Acute Myeloid Leukemia Cells Reveals Therapeutic Vulnerabilities
items.abstract_or_text: Venetoclax combined with azacitidine has improved treatment outcomes in acute myeloid leukemia (AML), yet relapse and treatment persistence remain major clinical challenges. To investigate proteomic mechanisms associated with venetoclax-azacitidine response and adaptation, we applied a multi-layer combinatorial proteome integral solubility/stability alteration analysis (CoPISA) strategy in SKM-1 AML cells. Cells were treated with venetoclax, azacitidine, their combination, or vehicle control and profiled across four orthogonal layers: short-term lysate CoPISA, short-term intact-cell CoPISA, long-term intact-cell CoPISA after 5 days of treatment, and long-term expression proteomics of surviving cells. The venetoclax-azacitidine combination induced treatment-specific protein solubility and abundance changes that were not fully reproduced by either single agent. Long-term surviving cells displayed extensive proteomic remodeling, consistent with the emergence of an adaptive drug-tolerant state, although contributions from pre-existing resilient cell populations cannot be excluded. Integration of short- and long-term solubility changes with abundance remodeling revealed distinct adaptive regimes, including retained biochemical targets, dosage-compensated targets, sensitive-state-specific targets, and remodeled adaptive targets. This framework prioritized candidate resistance-associated proteins, including NRP2, RPL18, PLP2, RPS28, and NOTCH1. NRP2 emerged as a top candidate across all proteomics layers, consistently showing increased abundance. Overall, this study shows that combining CoPISA with expression proteomics can resolve temporally distinct proteomic states of venetoclax-azacitidine response and identify candidate adaptive vulnerabilities in AML.
items.summary_zh: 多层 CoPISA 与表达蛋白组学描绘 venetoclax–azacitidine 处理后 AML 存活细胞的适应状态，并提出 NRP2 等候选脆弱性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将短期和长期蛋白稳定性、溶解度及丰度变化整合，能为耐药假说提供系统线索；证据目前来自 SKM-1 细胞。
items.abstract_zh: Venetoclax 联合 azacitidine 已改善急性髓系白血病（AML）的治疗结局，但复发和治疗持续存留仍是主要临床挑战。为研究与 venetoclax–azacitidine 响应和适应相关的蛋白质组机制，我们在 SKM-1 AML 细胞中应用了多层组合蛋白质组整体溶解度/稳定性改变分析（CoPISA）策略。细胞接受 venetoclax、azacitidine、二者联合或载体对照处理，并在四个正交层面进行分析：短期裂解液 CoPISA、短期完整细胞 CoPISA、处理 5 天后的长期完整细胞 CoPISA，以及存活细胞的长期表达蛋白质组学。Venetoclax–azacitidine 联合诱导了治疗特异性的蛋白溶解度和丰度变化，单药均不能完全重现。长期存活细胞显示广泛蛋白质组重塑，这与适应性耐药状态的出现一致，尽管不能排除预先存在的耐受细胞群所作的贡献。将短期和长期溶解度变化与丰度重塑整合后，揭示了不同的适应机制，包括保留的生化靶点、剂量补偿靶点、敏感状态特异性靶点和重塑的适应性靶点。该框架优先提出了候选耐药相关蛋白，包括 NRP2、RPL18、PLP2、RPS28 和 NOTCH1。NRP2 在所有蛋白质组层中均为顶级候选，其丰度持续升高。总体而言，本研究表明，将 CoPISA 与表达蛋白质组学相结合，能够解析 venetoclax–azacitidine 响应中时间上不同的蛋白质组状态，并识别 AML 中候选的适应性脆弱性。
items.author_line: Gholizadeh E, Vadadokhau U, Varli M, Ritz D, Javarappa KK, George B, Itzykson R, Varjosalo M, Kontro M, Renkonen R, Kankuri E, Haynes P, Saei AA, Jafari M

items.title: Combination of ALK2 and cholesterol targeting agents exploits linked genetic and metabolic dependencies in diffuse midline glioma
items.abstract_or_text: Diffuse midline glioma is an epigenetically driven disease defined by alterations targeting the histone post-translational modification H3K27me3 resulting in epigenetic rewiring and imposing unique metabolic dependencies. ACVR1-mutations arise in ~25% of DMG H3K27-altered patients and impart a selective dependency on the kinase it encodes (ALK2), however ALK2 inhibitors show modest single-agent efficacy in vivo. In an attempt to better understand the cellular consequences of ALK2 inhibition to identify mechanistically-driven drug combinations, integrated multi-omics analysis was performed and revealed a novel role for ALK2 in cholesterol homeostasis while CRISPR and high-throughput drug screens identified hits targeting cholesterol metabolism as sensitisers to ALK2i. In vivo assessment of ALK2i plus clinically well-tolerated statins revealed a significant increase in the median survival compared to vehicle. Forced differentiation of DMG cells from an oligodendrocyte precursor-like to an astrocyte-like cell-state and led to a significant decrease in ALK2i sensitivity and synergy with statins, which was phenocopied when DMG cells were co-cultured with normal astrocytes. We identify a previously unappreciated role for ALK2 signalling in cholesterol homeostasis, showing cell-state dependency, and identify a rational combinatorial strategy for clinical translation.
items.summary_zh: 多组学、CRISPR 和药物筛选将 DMG 中 ALK2 抑制剂与胆固醇靶向药物的联用，关联到细胞状态依赖的治疗脆弱性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 有机制筛选、细胞状态检验和小鼠生存证据的闭环；尚非临床疗效证据。
items.abstract_zh: 弥漫性中线胶质瘤是一种由表观遗传驱动的疾病，其特征是影响组蛋白翻译后修饰 H3K27me3 的改变，导致表观遗传重编程并形成独特的代谢依赖性。ACVR1 突变出现在约 25% 的 H3K27 改变型 DMG 患者中，并赋予其所编码激酶（ALK2）的选择性依赖；然而，ALK2 抑制剂在体内作为单药疗效有限。为更好理解 ALK2 抑制的细胞后果并识别机制驱动的药物组合，我们开展整合多组学分析，发现 ALK2 在胆固醇稳态中的新作用；CRISPR 和高通量药物筛选则识别出以胆固醇代谢为靶点、可使细胞对 ALK2i 敏感的命中物。对 ALK2i 加临床耐受性良好的 statins 的体内评估显示，与载体相比中位生存期显著增加。将 DMG 细胞从少突胶质细胞前体样细胞状态强制分化为星形胶质细胞样状态，导致其对 ALK2i 的敏感性以及与 statins 的协同作用显著降低；当 DMG 细胞与正常星形胶质细胞共培养时，也重现了该现象。我们识别了 ALK2 信号在胆固醇稳态中此前未被认识的作用，显示出细胞状态依赖性，并提出了一种具有临床转化依据的联合策略。
items.author_line: Rogers R, Grabovska Y, Mackay A, Carvalho D, Dobinson C, Pereira R, Burford A, Bevington L, Molinari V, Song J, Tari H, Ruddle R, Nkrumah J, Sejdiu D, Chew N, Tsui V, Sun C, Vinci M, Pericoli G, Becher O, Fortin J, Sampson P, Firestein R, Jones C

items.title: A cell death screen identifies macrophage-depleting agents with therapeutic potential
items.abstract_or_text: Macrophages are critical regulators of inflammation and tissue homeostasis, yet aberrant macrophage activation contributes to a wide spectrum of inflammatory and malignant diseases. Therapeutic strategies that directly reduce macrophage numbers have shown promise, but macrophage survival pathways remain incompletely defined, limiting the development of targeted therapeutic strategies. Here, we establish a high-throughput screening platform to identify small molecule inhibitors that impair macrophage survival. Screening a library of more than 2,000 targeted compounds in a cell survival assay, combined with in silico and in vitro analysis of macrophage specificity, revealed the identification of three potent inhibitors: BIX-01294, GSK-J4, and Masitinib. All three compounds downregulated leukemia inhibitory factor receptor (LIFR), whose inhibition markedly reduced macrophage viability. In vivo, these inhibitors effectively depleted large peritoneal macrophages, ameliorated key symptoms of macrophage activation syndrome (MAS), and suppressed tumor growth in a syngeneic transplanted melanoma model as well as in an autochthonous lung cancer model. Together, these findings identify small molecule-mediated macrophage depletion as a promising therapeutic strategy and establish an experimental approach to uncover regulators of macrophage survival.
items.summary_zh: 逾 2,000 种靶向化合物筛选识别出三种可耗竭巨噬细胞的候选药物，并在小鼠疾病模型中观察到表型改善。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 筛选、机制线索和多个体内模型相互支撑；候选药物的特异性、安全性与临床可转化性仍待验证。
items.abstract_zh: 巨噬细胞是炎症和组织稳态的关键调节者，但异常巨噬细胞活化促进广泛的炎症性和恶性疾病。直接减少巨噬细胞数量的治疗策略已显示出前景，但巨噬细胞存活通路仍未被充分定义，限制了靶向治疗策略的开发。在此，我们建立了一个高通量筛选平台，用于识别损害巨噬细胞存活的小分子抑制剂。在细胞存活测定中筛选包含超过 2,000 种靶向化合物的文库，并结合巨噬细胞特异性的计算和体外分析，识别出三种强效抑制剂：BIX-01294、GSK-J4 和 Masitinib。三种化合物均下调 leukemia inhibitory factor receptor（LIFR），而对 LIFR 的抑制显著降低巨噬细胞活力。在体内，这些抑制剂有效耗竭大型腹腔巨噬细胞，缓解巨噬细胞活化综合征（MAS）的关键症状，并在同系移植黑色素瘤模型和自发性肺癌模型中抑制肿瘤生长。综上，这些发现将小分子介导的巨噬细胞耗竭识别为一种有前景的治疗策略，并建立了一种实验方法以发现巨噬细胞存活的调节因子。
items.author_line: Ettel P, Forisch S, Traeger M, Mazic M, Mayr HK, Vogel A, Saha P, Davidovski L, Sango R, Atanasova VS, Gschwendtner A, Trenk C, Moll HP, Casanova E, Dolznig H, Hengstschlaeger M, Rattei T, Koren A, Kubicek S, Mikula M, Weichhart T

items.title: Direct microglia replacement reveals the impact of ontogeny on murine microglial responses to pathologic amyloid aggregation
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Microglia are central to the progression of many neurodegenerative diseases, especially Alzheimer’s Disease (AD). Adoptive transfer of engineered cells has demonstrated clinical benefit in oncology, autoimmune disease, and inherited blood disorders. Replacement of disease-affected microglia thus holds high therapeutic potential in AD, but how microglia replacement, including the source and ontogeny of donor microglia surrogates, fundamentally impacts AD neuropathology, is unresolved. We recently developed a microglia replacement approach based on engineered, inhibitor resistant CSF1R variants, that we here deployed in the 5xFAD model to better understand how microglia replacement impacts neuropathology and associated cell states spurred by aggressive amyloid aggregation. We achieved near-complete, direct microglia replacement prior to plaque accumulation, using ex vivo expanded hematopoietic stem cells (HSCs), Hoxb8 conditionally immortalized macrophages, and primary CD11b+ cells from early postnatal brain as donor sources. Although two months after transplant, CD11b+ brain cells slightly increased plaque burden, and conditionally immortalized macrophages slightly decreased astrogliosis, microglia replacement did not otherwise impact plaque burden, astrogliosis, nor the transcriptional state of astrocytes and oligodendrocytes as measured by single-cell RNA sequencing in 5 month old mice. In stark contrast, we found that donor cell ontogeny highly impacted both homeostatic and amyloid reactive macrophage state. In particular, and unlike transplanted microglia, HSC and Hoxb8 donor populations adopted a disease associated microglia (DAM)-like baseline state, but upon amyloid challenge, failed to effectively induce the complete DAM signature. Overall, these findings reveal large differences in the response of fetal origin compared with adult bone marrow-derived microglia to neuropathology, but that these large differences do not have a commensurate impact on the brain environment, important considerations for the development of microglia replacement therapies and the study of brain myeloid cell infiltration.
items.summary_zh: 在 5xFAD 小鼠中，近完全的小胶质细胞替换显示供体细胞本体来源强烈影响 DAM 样状态，却未相应改变整体脑病理环境。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 直接替换加单细胞 RNA 测序，区分了细胞状态变化与组织层面结局，对细胞治疗外推尤为关键。
items.abstract_zh: 小胶质细胞在许多神经退行性疾病，尤其是阿尔茨海默病（AD）的进展中居于核心地位。工程化细胞的过继转移已在肿瘤学、自身免疫疾病和遗传性血液疾病中显示临床获益。因此，替换受疾病影响的小胶质细胞在 AD 中具有很高治疗潜力，但小胶质细胞替换——包括供体小胶质细胞替代物的来源和本体发生——如何从根本上影响 AD 神经病理，仍未解决。我们最近开发了一种基于工程化、耐抑制剂 CSF1R 变体的小胶质细胞替换方法；在此将其部署于 5xFAD 模型，以更好理解小胶质细胞替换如何影响由侵袭性淀粉样蛋白聚集引发的神经病理和相关细胞状态。我们在斑块积累之前，利用离体扩增的造血干细胞（HSCs）、Hoxb8 条件永生化巨噬细胞以及早期出生后脑的原代 CD11b+ 细胞作为供体来源，实现了近完全、直接的小胶质细胞替换。移植两个月后，CD11b+ 脑细胞略微增加斑块负担，条件永生化巨噬细胞略微降低星形胶质细胞增生；但在 5 月龄小鼠中，小胶质细胞替换除此之外并未影响斑块负担、星形胶质细胞增生，也未影响单细胞 RNA 测序测得的星形胶质细胞和少突胶质细胞的转录状态。与之形成鲜明对比的是，我们发现供体细胞本体来源高度影响稳态和淀粉样蛋白反应性巨噬细胞状态。特别是，与移植的小胶质细胞不同，HSC 和 Hoxb8 供体群体呈现疾病相关小胶质细胞（DAM）样基线状态，但在淀粉样蛋白挑战后未能有效诱导完整 DAM 特征。总体而言，这些发现揭示了胎儿来源与成人骨髓来源小胶质细胞对神经病理反应的巨大差异，但这些巨大差异并未对脑环境产生相称影响；这对小胶质细胞替换疗法的开发及脑髓系细胞浸润的研究具有重要考量。
items.author_line: Oon CH, Levitt EM, Shapiro DA, O’Brien CA, Davis MR, Shestova O, Axsom J, Yaqoob F, Lomeikaitė V, Koumadorakis D, Milčiūtė M, Karosienė E, Shestov M, Anderson RN, Rahman RJ, Lombroso SI, Haney MS, Bennett ML, Gill S, Bennett FC

items.title: Single-cell immune repertoire atlas maps coordinated circulating adaptive immune states in inflammatory bowel disease
items.abstract_or_text: Single-cell studies have defined immune states in inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), but how adaptive receptor histories organize circulating immunity remains unclear. We generated a single-cell transcriptomic atlas of peripheral blood from 249 participants with Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis, or non-IBD control status, including 182 with productive TCR and BCR recovery. Expanded TCR clonotypes marked inflammatory-memory and cytotoxic states, while distinct but similar paired TCRs shared inflammatory programs across participants. BCR lineage maturation linked IgA-associated mucosal and plasma B cell programs to somatic mutation and class switching, distinguishing maturation-associated biology from clonal expansion. Helper, regulatory, and cytotoxic T-cell programs covaried with B-cell states, and inferred interactions nominated reciprocal antigen-presentation and helper pathways. Repertoire-based machine learning distinguished diagnosis, inflammation, and contemporaneous six-month treatment-response status. Together, this atlas connects receptor architecture to coordinated systemic immune remodeling, establishes a foundation for repertoire-informed patient stratification, and prioritizes candidate mechanisms of IBD pathogenesis.
items.summary_zh: 249 名参与者的外周血单细胞图谱把 TCR/BCR 克隆与成熟历史连接到 IBD 的协同适应性免疫状态。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 队列规模、配对受体恢复和单细胞图谱兼具，能为分层和机制假说提供资源；机器学习关联不代表治疗反应的因果决定因素。
items.abstract_zh: 单细胞研究已界定炎症性肠病（IBD）中的免疫状态，但适应性受体历史如何组织循环免疫仍不清楚。我们生成了来自 249 名克罗恩病、溃疡性结肠炎或非 IBD 对照状态参与者的外周血单细胞转录组图谱，其中 182 名获得了有效的 TCR 和 BCR 恢复。扩增的 TCR 克隆型标记炎症记忆和细胞毒性状态，而不同但相似的配对 TCR 在参与者间共享炎症程序。BCR 谱系成熟将 IgA 相关的黏膜和浆细胞程序与体细胞突变及类别转换相连，从而将成熟相关生物学与克隆扩增区分开来。辅助性、调节性和细胞毒性 T 细胞程序与 B 细胞状态协变，推断的相互作用提出了相互的抗原呈递和辅助通路。基于受体库的机器学习区分诊断、炎症和同时期六个月治疗响应状态。综上，该图谱将受体架构与协同的系统性免疫重塑相连接，为基于受体库的患者分层奠定基础，并优先提出 IBD 发病机制的候选机制。
items.author_line: Gubatan J, Ye J, Lund-Andersen C, Canas J, Zhou Y, Boye T, Hoang J, Sojwal R, Fardeen T, Tran T, Sokzini P, Koh AH, Gibson M, Huang Y, Peterson K, Sinha S, Rogalla S, Nielsen OH, Rosen MJ, Sandve GK

items.title: High-Dimensional Multi-omic Mapping of Post-Mortem Human Brain Using Iterative Indirect Immunofluorescence Imaging on Xenium-Processed Tissues
items.abstract_or_text: Spatial transcriptomics approaches provide crucial insights into gene expression distribution within intact tissue architecture, but they encounter limitations in detecting morphologically complex cell types, assessing their spatial associations with pathology, and accurately annotating cell types using RNA data alone. Therefore, we developed a robust post-processing workflow integrating Xenium spatial technology with iterative indirect immunofluorescence imaging (4i) on formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded (FFPE) human brain tissue. The post-Xenium 4i protocol presented here allows multi-omic tissue mapping, enabling deeper investigation of pathological microenvironments defined by the spatial distribution of neuropathological hallmarks and enrichment of specific cell populations. We applied this workflow on calcarine cortex tissue sections where cerebral amyloid angiopathy (CAA) burden is present, in addition to amyloid plaques and tau pathology, generating a 15-plex image that captures the complexity of the pathological microenvironment.
items.summary_zh: 该工作在 Xenium 处理后的 FFPE 人脑中建立 post-Xenium 4i 流程，实现空间转录组与 15 重免疫荧光图像整合。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 提供可在存档人脑组织上扩展的空间多组学工作流；目前展示来自带 CAA、淀粉样斑块和 tau 病理的皮层切片。
items.abstract_zh: 空间转录组学方法为完整组织结构内基因表达分布提供了关键见解，但在检测形态复杂的细胞类型、评估其与病理的空间关联，以及仅使用 RNA 数据准确注释细胞类型方面存在局限。因此，我们开发了一个稳健的后处理工作流，将 Xenium 空间技术与在福尔马林固定石蜡包埋（FFPE）人脑组织上的迭代间接免疫荧光成像（4i）相整合。本文提出的 post-Xenium 4i 协议允许进行多组学组织图谱绘制，从而能够更深入地研究由神经病理学标志物的空间分布和特定细胞群富集所界定的病理微环境。我们将该工作流应用于存在脑淀粉样血管病（CAA）负担、以及淀粉样斑块和 tau 病理的距状皮层组织切片，生成了一个捕捉病理微环境复杂性的 15 重图像。
items.author_line: Karaahmet B, Lama T, Wang A, Cao W, Menon V, Klein H, Bennett DA, De Jager P, Zhang Y, Taga M

items.title: Depletion of the isocitrate dehydrogenase 3 subunit IDHA-1 licenses germ cell-to-neuron direct reprogramming in C. elegans
items.abstract_or_text: Direct reprogramming (DR) converts one differentiated cell identity into another and is a promising strategy for regenerative approaches when cells are lost because of injury or disease. Transcription factors (TFs) that specify a given cell type can drive DR, but inhibitory mechanisms restrict this conversion in most cell types. To identify such barriers in vivo, we use Caenorhabditis elegans and the zinc finger TF CHE-1, which is required to specify the glutamatergic taste neuron fate of ASE neurons. Ectopic CHE-1 expression can induce DR of different cell types to ASE neurons upon RNAi-mediated depletion of barrier genes. Here we characterize the α subunit of the mitochondrial isocitrate dehydrogenase 3 complex (IDH3), IDHA-1, as a barrier to DR of germ cells into neurons. RNAi against idha-1 produced consistent ASE fate reporter expression, accompanied by morphological changes to neuron-like structures in the germline upon ectopic CHE-1 expression. Using different neuronal gene expression reporters, single-molecule FISH, and antibody staining, we confirm that this germ cell conversion (GeCo) produces neuron-like cells. We found that loss of IDH3 activity causes metabolic perturbations that result in a variety of direct and indirect effects on DR of germ cells. One arm implicates the hypoxia-inducible factor HIF-1, which promotes GeCo. Its loss causes a significant decrease, while the vhl-1 mutant background, in which HIF-1 protein is stabilized, leads to enhanced GeCo. Another arm implicates epigenetic changes leading to a detectable loss of the repressive histone marks H3K27me3 and H3K9me3 upon idha-1 depletion. Furthermore, stable-isotope-resolved metabolomics shows strong citrate accumulation without a noteworthy drop in α-Ketoglutarate (αKG) levels, indicating that compensatory pathways maintain αKG levels. Genetics and metabolomics analyses confirmed that Glutamate anaplerosis contributes to compensating for the loss of IDHA-1. Additionally, we found that depletion of glucose transporter FDGT-2 nearly doubles GeCo efficiency. Overall, our findings define the TCA cycle as an in vivo safeguard of germ cell identity and show that multiple metabolic inputs converge to keep germ cells refractory to TF-induced DR to neuronal cells.
items.summary_zh: 在线虫中，IDHA-1 缺失通过 HIF-1、表观遗传和代谢途径解除生殖细胞向神经元直接重编程的屏障。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 遗传学、单分子 FISH、稳定同位素代谢组学共同支持 TCA 循环与细胞身份维持的联系。
items.abstract_zh: 直接重编程（DR）将一种分化细胞身份转换为另一种；当细胞因损伤或疾病丢失时，它是再生策略中一种有前景的方法。指定某一细胞类型的转录因子（TFs）可驱动 DR，但在大多数细胞类型中，抑制机制限制这种转换。为在体内识别这类屏障，我们使用 Caenorhabditis elegans 和锌指 TF CHE-1；CHE-1 是指定 ASE 神经元谷氨酸能味觉神经元命运所必需的。异位表达 CHE-1 可在通过 RNAi 耗竭屏障基因后，诱导不同细胞类型直接重编程为 ASE 神经元。在此，我们将线粒体异柠檬酸脱氢酶 3 复合物（IDH3）的 α 亚基 IDHA-1 表征为生殖细胞向神经元直接重编程的屏障。针对 idha-1 的 RNAi 在异位 CHE-1 表达时产生一致的 ASE 命运报告基因表达，并伴随生殖系中向神经元样结构的形态学改变。使用不同神经元基因表达报告基因、单分子 FISH 和抗体染色，我们确认这种生殖细胞转换（GeCo）产生神经元样细胞。我们发现，IDH3 活性丧失造成代谢扰动，进而对生殖细胞 DR 产生多种直接和间接效应。其中一条支路涉及促进 GeCo 的缺氧诱导因子 HIF-1；其缺失导致 GeCo 显著下降，而 HIF-1 蛋白被稳定的 vhl-1 突变背景则使 GeCo 增强。另一条支路涉及表观遗传改变，在 idha-1 耗竭后可检测到抑制性组蛋白标记 H3K27me3 和 H3K9me3 的丢失。此外，稳定同位素分辨代谢组学显示柠檬酸显著积累，而 α-Ketoglutarate（αKG）水平没有显著下降，表明代偿通路维持 αKG 水平。遗传和代谢组学分析确认，Glutamate 补充反应有助于补偿 IDHA-1 的丧失。另外，我们发现耗竭葡萄糖转运体 FDGT-2 几乎使 GeCo 效率翻倍。总体而言，我们的发现将 TCA 循环界定为体内生殖细胞身份的保障机制，并表明多种代谢输入汇聚，使生殖细胞对 TF 诱导的神经元 DR 保持抵抗状态。
items.author_line: Fatima NU, Reid A, Shadfar A, Blume A, Opialla T, Kempa S, Tursun B

items.title: MOM-PD: Multimodal Biomarker Optimization for Parkinson's Disease Machine learning-assisted multimodal detection and clinical staging
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Background: Parkinson's disease (PD) diagnosis relies primarily on clinical motor examination, and the prodromal phase preceding overt motor manifestations remains difficult to identify. No single biomarker modality has been shown to be both sensitive and specific across the full disease spectrum, and how best to integrate multimodal data for stage-specific detection is unclear. Objective: To optimize a multimodal biomarker framework using machine learning based on Parkinson's Progression Markers Initiative (PPMI) data, and to define stage-specific biomarkerpanels for manifest PD detection, prodromal identification, and longitudinal progression monitoring. Methods: We analyzed 948 PPMI participants (445 PD, 389 prodromal, 111 healthy controls [HC], 3 SWEDD) with 18 candidate biomarkers spanning dopamine transporter SPECT (DaTscanSBR), structural MRI (FreeSurfer 7 cortical and subcortical metrics), diffusion tensor imaging (DTI), and MDS-UPDRS Parts I–IV. Feature-wide association analysis with Mann-Whitney U tests and Cohen's d was followed by random forest Gini importance ranking. Random forest classifiers (500 trees, 5-fold stratified cross-validation) were trained on three feature sets: (1) DaTscan + clinical; (2) structural MRI only; (3) full multimodal combination. Four-year longitudinal trajectories (BL, V06, V10) of motor scores and grey matter volume were characterized. Results: For PD vs HC, the DaTscan-clinical model achieved near-perfect discrimination (AUC = 0.999, 95% CI 0.997–1.000), far exceeding structural MRI alone (AUC = 0.526). Top discriminative features were putaminal SBR, striatal SBR, and MDS-UPDRS Part III motor score. Prodromal vs HC discrimination was more challenging (AUC = 0.700), with subcortical grey matteratrophy as the leading signal while DaTscan SBR was non-discriminative (P = 0.43). PD vs prodromal classification was excellent (AUC = 0.984). Longitudinally, PD motor scores increased ~1.5 points/year and grey matter volume declined ~0.85%/year. Conclusions: Multimodal biomarkers display staging-dependent complementarity: DaTscan and motor scales dominate manifest PD identification, while subcortical volumetric MRI enablesprodromal detection. Stage-tailored biomarker panels support improved PD phenotyping and early screening for clinical trial enrichment.
items.summary_zh: 基于 948 名 PPMI 参与者的随机森林分析显示，DaTscan 与运动量表对显性 PD 判别最强，而前驱期判别表现有限。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 多模态、纵向且包含较大公开队列；结果来自交叉验证，不能等同于前瞻性临床筛查效能。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景：帕金森病（PD）诊断主要依赖临床运动检查，而在明显运动表现出现之前的前驱期仍难以识别。尚无单一生物标志物模态被证明在整个疾病谱中同时具有敏感性和特异性，并且如何最好地整合多模态数据用于分期特异性检测尚不明确。目的：使用基于 Parkinson's Progression Markers Initiative（PPMI）数据的机器学习，优化多模态生物标志物框架，并为显性 PD 检测、前驱期识别和纵向进展监测界定分期特异性生物标志物面板。方法：我们分析了 948 名 PPMI 参与者（445 名 PD、389 名前驱期、111 名健康对照［HC］、3 名 SWEDD）的 18 个候选生物标志物，涵盖多巴胺转运体 SPECT（DaTscanSBR）、结构 MRI（FreeSurfer 7 皮层和皮层下指标）、弥散张量成像（DTI）和 MDS-UPDRS 第 I–IV 部分。以 Mann-Whitney U 检验和 Cohen's d 进行全特征关联分析后，采用随机森林 Gini 重要性排序。以三个特征集训练随机森林分类器（500 棵树、5 折分层交叉验证）：（1）DaTscan + 临床；（2）仅结构 MRI；（3）完整多模态组合。对运动评分和灰质体积的四年纵向轨迹（BL、V06、V10）进行了刻画。结果：对于 PD 与 HC，DaTscan–临床模型实现近乎完美的判别（AUC = 0.999，95% CI 0.997–1.000），远优于仅结构 MRI（AUC = 0.526）。最具判别力的特征是壳核 SBR、纹状体 SBR 和 MDS-UPDRS 第 III 部分运动评分。前驱期与 HC 的判别更具挑战性（AUC = 0.700），其中皮层下灰质萎缩为主要信号，而 DaTscan SBR 无判别性（P = 0.43）。PD 与前驱期分类表现优异（AUC = 0.984）。纵向来看，PD 运动评分每年增加约 1.5 分，灰质体积每年下降约 0.85%。结论：多模态生物标志物显示分期依赖的互补性：DaTscan 和运动量表主导显性 PD 识别，而皮层下容积 MRI 支持前驱期检测。分期定制的生物标志物面板支持改进 PD 表型分层和临床试验富集的早期筛查。
items.author_line: Li X, Xu L, Feng L, Qi M, Hu Q, Yang* G

items.title: PE-Tab2Conv: Clinically structured convolutional representation learning for preeclampsia risk modelling from routine electronic health records
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Background: Machine-learning decision support from routine electronic health records requires representations that handle class imbalance while retaining clinically interpretable structure. We developed PE-Tab2Conv, a clinically structured tabular-to-matrix representation for preeclampsia risk modelling. Methods: Encoded maternal variables were arranged in a fixed 4 \times 6 matrix spanning baseline and socioeconomic characteristics, obstetric history, extended obstetric and family history, and comorbidities. A lightweight two-dimensional convolutional neural network produced 32-dimensional embeddings for downstream classifiers. Models were evaluated on a locked 2023 temporal cohort from RS Adhyatma (n=531), comparing a portable core feature space (17 predictors) with an extended space (21 predictors). Interpretability used SHapley Additive exPlanations and matrix-cell occlusion. A second hospital contributed 72 preeclampsia-positive records for positive-case transportability assessment. Results: In the extended setting, PE-Tab2Conv with logistic regression achieved an area under the precision--recall curve of 0.817 (area under the receiver operating characteristic curve 0.922; Brier score 0.047), numerically above extended tabular XGBoost (0.800). The extended-to-core gain was primarily associated with historical predictors; prior preeclampsia had the largest cell-level occlusion effect (\DeltaAUPRC=0.210). External positive cases retained elevated model scores, but the absence of external controls precluded full external validation. Conclusions: PE-Tab2Conv offers a compact, traceable representation-learning method for health-informatics risk modelling and potential clinical decision-support development. Balanced multicentre validation is required before deployment.
items.summary_zh: PE-Tab2Conv 将孕妇临床表格变量编码为 4×6 矩阵，以卷积表征学习预测子痫前期风险，并在时间留出队列上评估。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 模型设计紧凑、可解释，且明确说明外部队列仅有阳性病例，避免把运输性检验误作完整外部验证。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景：基于常规电子健康记录的机器学习决策支持需要能够处理类别不平衡、同时保留临床可解释结构的表征。我们开发了 PE-Tab2Conv，一种具有临床结构的表格到矩阵表征，用于子痫前期风险建模。方法：将编码后的孕妇变量排列为固定的 4 × 6 矩阵，涵盖基线及社会经济特征、产科病史、扩展产科和家族病史以及合并症。轻量级二维卷积神经网络产生 32 维嵌入，供下游分类器使用。模型在 RS Adhyatma 的锁定 2023 年时间队列（n=531）上评估，比较便携核心特征空间（17 个预测因子）与扩展空间（21 个预测因子）。可解释性使用 SHapley Additive exPlanations 和矩阵单元遮挡。第二家医院提供了 72 条子痫前期阳性记录，用于阳性病例可迁移性评估。结果：在扩展设定中，采用逻辑回归的 PE-Tab2Conv 获得 0.817 的精确率–召回率曲线下面积（受试者工作特征曲线下面积 0.922；Brier score 0.047），数值上高于扩展表格 XGBoost（0.800）。扩展相对于核心空间的增益主要与病史预测因子相关；既往子痫前期具有最大的单元遮挡效应（ΔAUPRC=0.210）。外部阳性病例仍保持较高模型评分，但由于缺乏外部对照，无法进行完整的外部验证。结论：PE-Tab2Conv 为健康信息学风险建模和潜在临床决策支持开发提供了一种紧凑、可追溯的表征学习方法。在部署前仍需要平衡的多中心验证。
items.author_line: Rakasiwi S, Salam A, Dewi IN, Utomo DW, Octaviani DA, Wright S

items.title: Protein language models predict artemisinin partial resistance and prioritize genetic modifiers in Plasmodium falciparum
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Artemisinin partial resistance threatens malaria control, but molecular surveillance relies largely on established K13 variants, limiting interpretation of emerging sequence variation. Here we used ESM-3 protein representations to model resistance in 1,293 Plasmodium falciparum clinical isolates. K13 sequence models generalized across temporally independent cohorts (auROC > 0.88; auPR > 0.83) and retained predictive information for geographically distinct and previously unseen K13 substitutions, correctly classifying 13 of 17 variants absent from training. Extending the framework to 167 ART-R-associated candidate genes recovered established resistance loci and provided complementary predictive information to training-selected single-variant markers. Model-based prioritization identified EXO E415G, and CRISPR–Cas9 editing showed that E415G increased ring-stage survival only in parasites carrying K13 C580Y, whereas ATP4 G1128R had no measurable effect. These findings establish protein-sequence modeling as a complementary approach for prioritizing emerging resistance-associated variation and context-dependent genetic modifiers.
items.summary_zh: ESM-3 表征在 1,293 份恶性疟原虫临床分离株中预测青蒿素部分耐药，并以 CRISPR 验证 EXO E415G 的 K13 背景依赖效应。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 跨时间和地理队列的评估再加遗传编辑，为蛋白语言模型提出的候选修饰因子提供较强但仍有限的实验支持。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要 青蒿素部分耐药威胁疟疾防控，但分子监测主要依赖已确立的 K13 变异，限制了对新出现序列变异的解读。在此，我们使用 ESM-3 蛋白表征，在 1,293 份 Plasmodium falciparum 临床分离株中对耐药性建模。K13 序列模型可在时间独立队列中泛化（auROC > 0.88；auPR > 0.83），并保留对地理上不同及此前未见 K13 替换的预测信息，正确分类了训练中缺失的 17 个变异中的 13 个。将该框架扩展至 167 个 ART-R 相关候选基因后，恢复了已知耐药位点，并为训练选择的单变异标记提供了互补的预测信息。基于模型的排序识别出 EXO E415G；CRISPR–Cas9 编辑显示，E415G 仅在携带 K13 C580Y 的寄生虫中提高环状期存活率，而 ATP4 G1128R 没有可测量效应。这些发现将蛋白序列建模确立为一种互补方法，用于优先识别新出现的耐药相关变异和背景依赖的遗传修饰因子。
